descripcion.1: I'm Jhunior Mendoza, a systems developer and cybersecurity professional with an offensive focus. Currently studying Systems Engineering at UPN with a technical degree in Information Systems Development.
descripcion.2: I operate my own Red Team and Blue Team labs on Fedora and Arch Linux using Podman and VMware. My security stack includes Nmap, Metasploit, Burp Suite, Wireshark and Splunk for attack-defense simulations.
descripcion.3: On the development side, I build interfaces with React and Laravel, automate workflows with n8n and implement advanced analytics. I aim to create technology that is as robust in security as it is in user experience.
